## Corpus reconciliation (why the grid holds 456, not 463)

- **463 combat kits** in `canon_engine_key` (row_class='combat-kit').
- **6 kits** have `mob_policy_while_casting='unknown'` → UNMAPPED strip: `poe2-archmage-totems`, `poe2-shaman-bear`, `poe2-snipe-mirage-deadeye`, `poe2-spiral-volley`, `poe2-walking-calamity`, `poe2-whirling-assault-ma`. All are post-cutoff PoE2 kits with movement policy not yet keyed.
- **1 kit** pure-mobility residual → UNMAPPED strip: `poe2-temporalis-blink` (no damage; no delivery family fits). Carries over from V1.1.
- **Grid holds 456 kits** = 463 − 6 unknown-movement − 1 pure-mobility. Every kit accounted for.

## Comparison against V1.1 headline

| Metric | V1.1 (B′ commitment×delivery) | **V1.2 (RULED movement×delivery×amp)** | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Occupied cells | 18 / 21 | **20 / 21** | +2 (11% more populated) |
| Empty-cell % | 14.3% | **4.8%** | −9.5 pts |
| Max-cell pileup | 109 kits | **65 kits** | **−40%** (pileup redistributes across 3 movement rows) |
| Cell-grain HHI | 0.157 | **0.081** | **−48%** (halved) |
| UNMAPPED (residual) | 1 corpus | 1 residual + 6 movement-unknown = **7 corpus** | +6 (all keying-gap, not semantic) |

**Interpretation.** The movement axis dissolves V1.1's dominant `SNAP` row (413 of 463 kits) into three meaningfully-populated rows (FREE-MOVE 268 / WALK 108 / ROOTED 80). The concentration reduces almost linearly with the row split. The max-cell drops from 109 (SNAP×PROJECTILE — a "shooter" pileup that was archetype-legible but dense) to 65 (FREE-MOVE×PROJECTILE — the same archetype, now scoped to "shooter that can move while shooting"). The 44 shooter kits that dropped out of FREE-MOVE×PROJECTILE went to WALK×PROJECTILE (36) and ROOTED×PROJECTILE (22) — a genuine gameplay split (kite-shooters vs walk-and-shoot vs planted-turret-shooters).

**HHI 0.081** is entering healthy-distribution territory for a 21-cell surface. Bucket-grain HHI 0.046 across 63 buckets is even flatter — the amp stratification catches structural sub-variation that the cell-grain hides.

## Empty-bucket list (13 / 63)

Empty buckets are the design-frontier surface Matt's stratification ruling is designed to expose. All addresses use the (movement · amp · column) form:

| # | Movement | Amp | Column | Read |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FREE-MOVE | SPIKY | BEAM | Kiting sustained beams that also spike don't exist yet |
| 2 | FREE-MOVE | VAR | BEAM | (Variable-amp mobile beam) — genuine whitespace |
| 3 | WALK | FLAT | BEAM | (See row-3 empty cell) |
| 4 | WALK | SPIKY | BEAM | (See row-3 empty cell) |
| 5 | WALK | VAR | BEAM | (See row-3 empty cell) — WALK×BEAM is the empty cell |
| 6 | WALK | VAR | MELEE | Variable-amp walking melee (choose-your-window swings) |
| 7 | WALK | VAR | SUMMON | Variable-amp walking summons (uptime-throttled totems) |
| 8 | ROOTED | SPIKY | ORBITAL | Rooted spiky orbital (charge-and-release rotating construct) |
| 9 | ROOTED | VAR | ORBITAL | Rooted variable-amp orbital |
| 10 | ROOTED | VAR | NOVA | Rooted variable-amp nova |
| 11 | ROOTED | VAR | BEAM | Rooted variable-amp beam (channel-with-modulation) |
| 12 | ROOTED | VAR | MELEE | Rooted variable-amp melee (planted charge-strike) |
| 13 | ROOTED | VAR | SUMMON | Rooted variable-amp summon |

**Read.** VAR is empty in 12 of 13 empty-bucket rows — this is the corpus-wide scarcity signal Matt flagged (only 34 var kits total, spread thin). ROOTED×VAR is empty in 5 of 7 columns; the 4 rooted-var kits all live in exactly two columns: PROJECTILE (3: `d2-wind-druid`, `poe1-crackling-lance`, `poe2-spark-stormweaver`) and ZONE (1: `d2-fire-druid`). BEAM×VAR is empty in every row.

**Design-lens.** The empty ROOTED×VAR band is the strongest empty-strata signal: 5 empty buckets across 7 columns, corpus-wide. Only 4 rooted-var kits total, all in PROJECTILE (3) and ZONE (1) — leaving 5 columns (ORBITAL, NOVA, BEAM, MELEE, SUMMON) with zero variable-amplitude rooted-caster options. If future design wants a "planted variable-cadence" archetype (e.g., rooted-cast beam with modulated pulses, rooted-cast summon with escalating waves), 5 whole columns are open frontier here.

The `WALK × BEAM` column-cell empty is the plane-wide honest gap: walking-while-channeling-a-beam is a rare movement-cast combination in the corpus (only 8 BEAM kits total, 2 FREE-MOVE + 0 WALK + 6 ROOTED — the walk-beam middle-ground doesn't exist).
